title: O-VGG CIFAR-10 offline software-evaluation sample
scope: Matched standalone software evaluation; hardware control and physical optical deployment are not implemented by this example.

model_configuration.padding: reflect one column on the right and one row on the bottom
model_configuration.training_mode: hard-STE: nearest-grid forward pass with adjacent-column interpolation gradients

response_preprocessing: For each output row: subtract the mean, divide by the sample standard deviation plus 1e-6, and multiply by 0.20.
